{{Top}}
[[File:BibFortuna-SWEnc.png|thumb|250px|Jabba the Hutt's majordomo, Bib Fortuna.]]
A '''majordomo''' was the head ''(major)'' person of a domestic staff ''(domo)'', one who acted on behalf of a usually absent owner of a typically very large residence or corporation. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] childhood friend [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] hoped to one day be a majordomo for a wealthy [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] estate, which he thought was the highest position a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] could obtain.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> 

Numerous majordomos were employed by members of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Clans]] as their chief subordinate. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] was the majordomo of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] palace on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The [[Ansionian]] [[Ogomoor]] was another such majordomo who served [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg the Hutt]] and his interests on [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="TAS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

The [[Yevetha]]n [[Nil Spaar]] also had a majordomo that happened to accompany him<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>.
[[Ob Fortuna]] was the majordomo for [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] and the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].
